notes: I changed the multi-word handling: later words are stripped of the first word's letters and then **concatenated together** (no spaces between them) after the first word, which fixes "a b c"→"a bch". I also revised the h-append rule: the last word gets 'h' only when the first word doesn't end in 'o'/'y', unless the tail ends in 's' (which explains "two words"→"two rdsh" while "hello cat"→"helo cat"
